rules: Single source of truth for every FAQ question and answer on the site. Every page's FAQ section and the /faq hub render from this file — never retype an answer.
Text is final copy (US English). Do not paraphrase, add claims or change numbers. Prices must match content/pricing.json.
Items with status "confirm" are owner questions (IMPLEMENTATION_STATUS.md §2). They are NOT rendered until the owner confirms the answer; the safe default is to omit them.
applies_to lists the products the answer is true for. On the /faq hub, an item that applies to only one product shows a small mono product tag (S PROTOCOL / S INVOICE) next to the question.
Answers are plain text; 'links' are optional inline links to render after the answer text.
Each item's id is its DOM id on the /faq hub (deep link /faq#<id>) and the value of the faq_toggle 'question' property.

items.question: Do I pay per technician?
items.answer: No. S Protocol Pro has no team-member limit and no per-seat charge. Add the dispatchers and technicians the business actually employs.

items.question: Can I pay yearly?
items.answer: Yes — $249.99/yr for S Protocol ($20.83/mo) or $49.99/yr for S Invoice ($4.17/mo).

items.question: Is S Protocol priced per technician?
items.answer: No — $24.99/mo or $249.99/yr for the whole business.

items.question: Can I add technicians for the summer?
items.answer: Yes. There's no team-member limit, so adding a technician doesn't change the price.

items.question: Is there a free trial of Pro?
items.answer: No. There's a Free plan with a real allowance instead, and it uses the same product Pro does — not a stripped-down demo. We'd rather you test the real thing than race a countdown.

items.question: What happens when I hit the Free limit?
items.answer: You can't create new records of that kind until you upgrade. Nothing is hidden, locked or deleted — every job, invoice, payment and customer you already have stays fully readable. The allowance is one-time per business, not monthly, and deleting a document doesn't give it back.

items.question: What if I stop paying?
items.answer: Your data is never held hostage. If a subscription lapses or is canceled, you keep read access to everything and drop back to Free limits for creating new records. Canceling mid-period keeps Pro running until the period you paid for ends.

items.question: I subscribed through the App Store — how do I cancel?
items.answer: In your Apple account's subscription settings; Apple handles App Store billing.

items.question: Can I switch between monthly and yearly?
items.safe_default: Omit this item until the owner confirms the answer.

items.question: Do both products work on iPhone?
items.answer: Yes — both run on the web and on iPhone. There's no Android app, and we won't claim one until there is.

items.question: Does it work on iPhone and Android?
items.answer: S Protocol runs on the web and on iPhone. There's no Android app, and we won't claim one until there is.

items.question: Does S Invoice work on iPhone?
items.answer: Yes — on the web and with S Invoice for iPhone. There's no Android app.

items.question: Is there an Android app?
items.answer: No. S Protocol runs on the web and on iPhone.

items.question: Can I move from S Invoice to S Protocol later?
items.answer: Yes, and it isn't a migration. S Protocol is activated on the same workspace, so your customers, invoices, estimates, company details and invoice numbering are simply still there. The owner starts it from Settings, and that first activation is on a paid S Protocol plan. A free S Protocol account is instead a separate signup with an empty workspace.

items.question: Can I use both products at once?
items.answer: Yes. A workspace with both keeps its S Invoice side working exactly as before. Customers are shared across both; invoices raised against dispatched jobs stay on the S Protocol side, so your invoicing list doesn't fill up with operational paperwork.

items.question: Can technicians see a customer's past visits?
items.answer_held_back: Yes. The job record carries the customer's history — previous visits, notes, photos and what was paid — in the office and on the technician's iPhone.
items.safe_default: Omit until the owner confirms. Pass 2 read-only check of the app: a client's job history is on the client record the office uses; the technician role cannot open client records, so the 'on the technician's iPhone' part is not supported today.

items.question: Which currencies can I invoice in?
items.answer: S Invoice documents can be in USD, CAD, EUR or GBP, and online card payments work in all four. The currency is stamped when the document is created and never converted afterward. S Protocol works in USD, and in-person card payments are USD only for now.

items.question: Which currencies does S Protocol use?
items.answer: S Protocol works in USD, and in-person card payments are USD.

items.question: Can customers pay online?
items.answer: Yes — card payments from the invoice link, through Stripe (set up with you).

items.question: Can my technicians take payment at the door?
items.answer: Yes — with Tap to Pay on iPhone or a card reader (USD), or by recording a cash payment.

items.question: Do I need Stripe?
items.answer: Only to take card payments online. Without it you can still send invoices and record cash and check payments.

items.question: Does my customer need an account to pay?
items.answer: No. They open the link and pay by card.

items.question: How do integrations get set up?
items.answer: Stripe, Tap to Pay on iPhone and card readers, and website lead intake are live — we set them up with you. Quo, Thumbtack and API access are built case by case, so talk to us first.

items.question: Do integrations cost extra?
items.answer: Every integration is included in Pro — some need setup with us first.
items.answer_if_confirmed: Every integration is included in Pro — some need setup with us first. Card-processing fees are charged by the payment provider.
items.note: Use answer_if_confirmed only after the owner confirms D-11.

items.question: Can I connect something that isn't listed?
items.answer: Ask — API access and webhooks are available by request.
